s01_01.text: Hello, friends! Today we learn our ABCs!

s01_02.text: Beep beep! Let's find some letters!

s05_02.text: And B is for bus! That's me!

s13_02.text: F is for fish and flower, too!

s15_02.text: And G is for green grass!

s16_02.text: And H is for hop! Hop, hop, hop!

s19_02.text: Lumi, play the letter game with us!

s20_01.text: Which one is the letter B?

s21_01.text: Which one is the letter H?

s22_01.text: A, apple. B, ball. C, cat. D, duck.

s22_02.text: E, egg. F, frog. G, grapes. H, house.

s23_01.text: Next time, we find more letters!

s23_02.text: Beep beep! Time to go home!
